subject.title: Bug: Billing error (402) causes infinite retry death spiral for inline-apiKey providers (no backoff)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt persisted provider-level cooldown identity for inline `models.providers.<id>.apiKey` credentials, including fail-closed behavior during auth/billing cooldown windows?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the fix changes auth-provider behavior for existing inline-key users and needs maintainer acceptance before the linked PR or a replacement can land.

options.title: Accept provider-level cooldown
options.body: Land or rebuild the linked fix so inline keys get billing/auth cooldown protection while healthy stored profiles remain available as fallback.

options.title: Keep profile-only cooldowns
options.body: Treat auth profiles as the supported cooldown boundary and document moving inline keys into profiles as the supported workaround.

options.title: Request a narrower design
options.body: Pause the linked PR until maintainers specify the exact cooldown identity, persistence, and recovery behavior they want.

recommendation.title: Accept provider-level cooldown
recommendation.body: Land or rebuild the linked fix so inline keys get billing/auth cooldown protection while healthy stored profiles remain available as fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: The auth-profile/model-config redesign and recent credential-injection work make this the closest product and compatibility ownership signal.
